title: Before You Share That Photograph
summaryZh: 一張看似即時的災難照片可能來自多年以前，文章示範如何在分享前查找原始脈絡。

sentences.text: Last summer, a dramatic photograph appeared in my neighborhood message group during a severe storm.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，一場強烈暴風雨期間，我的社區群組裡出現了一張驚人的照片。

sentences.text: It showed a bridge almost completely underwater, and the caption warned drivers to stay home.
sentences.zh: 照片裡一座橋幾乎完全淹沒，說明文字警告駕駛人待在家裡。

sentences.text: Several people shared it immediately because the sky outside looked dark enough to make the claim believable.
sentences.zh: 好幾個人立刻轉傳，因為外頭的天空夠陰暗，讓這個說法顯得可信。

sentences.text: However, the bridge in the picture did not look familiar, even though I had crossed ours hundreds of times.
sentences.zh: 然而，照片裡的橋看起來並不熟悉，儘管我已走過本地那座橋數百次。

sentences.text: I saved the image and used a reverse image search to find earlier copies online.
sentences.zh: 我把圖片存下來，用以圖搜圖尋找網路上更早的版本。

sentences.text: Within a minute, I found the same photograph in a news report published six years earlier.
sentences.zh: 不到一分鐘，我就在一篇六年前刊登的新聞報導中找到同一張照片。

sentences.text: The flooding had happened in another country, and the original bridge was more than a thousand kilometers away.
sentences.zh: 那場洪水發生在另一個國家，原本的橋距離我們超過一千公里。

sentences.text: The photograph was genuine, but the new caption had removed the facts that gave it meaning.
sentences.zh: 照片本身是真的，但新的說明文字拿掉了賦予它意義的事實。

sentences.text: This kind of error is effective because people often treat an image as evidence before asking what it actually proves.
sentences.zh: 這種錯誤很有迷惑力，因為人們常先把影像當成證據，卻沒有追問它究竟證明了什麼。

sentences.text: A cropped picture may hide a street sign, a date, or another detail that would expose the mistake.
sentences.zh: 經過裁切的圖片可能藏起路牌、日期，或其他足以揭穿錯誤的細節。

sentences.text: Even image metadata can be useful, although it can also be changed and should not be trusted alone.
sentences.zh: 即使圖片的中繼資料也可能有用，不過它同樣可以被修改，不能單獨信任。

sentences.text: The strongest check is usually to locate the earliest reliable source and read what it says about the image.
sentences.zh: 最有力的查證通常是找出最早的可靠來源，並閱讀它對圖片的說明。

sentences.text: I posted the old article in the group, and the person who shared the warning quickly corrected it.
sentences.zh: 我在群組貼出舊報導，原本分享警告的人很快就更正了內容。

sentences.text: By then, though, the false version had already reached several other groups that never saw the correction.
sentences.zh: 但到了那時，錯誤版本已傳進好幾個永遠看不到更正的群組。

sentences.text: That is why a quiet minute of checking before you share can matter more than a loud correction afterward.
sentences.zh: 所以分享前安靜查證一分鐘，可能比事後大聲更正更有用。

questions.q: What first made the writer doubt the photograph?
options: The bridge did not look like the local bridge
The photograph was too blurry to understand

questions.q: What did the reverse image search reveal?
options: The photograph had been created by software
The same flood happened every summer
The photograph came from another country six years earlier

questions.q: What does the writer consider the strongest way to check an image?
options: Checking whether friends have shared it
